description: Bar-parity gate for Q_β chain D (Type-B folded crystal). Type-B content is bar-involution invariant; tests whether the c_k are. c₂ even/constant (bar-invariant ✓); c₃ = -2 - ℏ_q² is bar-MIXED (invariant -2 Jones core + bar-covariant -ℏ_q² tail), so a uniformly bar-invariant Type-B crystal cannot reproduce c₃. REFUTE D as the single kernel; the ladder is parity-split (crystal even rungs × Jones-Hopf odd rungs). No fit.

data.verdict: REFUTE-D-as-single-kernel; ladder is parity-split (crystal even × Jones-Hopf odd)

caveats: c₄ even-rung is flagged a normalisation artifact (PR #1786); the gate rests on c₂ (constant) and c₃ (= -2-ℏ_q², fully determined, no Hoefsmit b). The c₁=cos rung needs α(q) and is not tested here.
Structural-constraint (prune) result: refutes Type-B as the c₃ kernel and redirects to a parity-split kernel. Nothing wired; c_k stay cal-anchored.
